points.text: Access is managed through users, roles, permissions, and product-level access.
A sandbox is a logical partition in an Experience Platform environment used to isolate assets and data for development, testing, or production.
Channel administration establishes the infrastructure and identity configuration needed to deliver messages.
A unitary event is associated with an individual profile and can trigger an individual journey.
Coordinate channels around customer state and preferences, not by blindly sending the same message everywhere.
Re-entry is a business rule.
Minimum test matrix: eligible profile; missing optional attribute; missing required identity/address; no consent/opt-out; already converted; duplicate event; action success; action business…
Read metrics as a funnel: eligible/entered → progressed → branched → action executed → accepted by provider → delivered/engaged where reporting supports it.
Eligibility answers can this offer be shown?
Simulation verifies candidate offers and the decision result for a selected profile/context.
Your reading list also names the Decisions Hub API as a delivery path.
Content authoring includes channel-specific configuration, rendering, personalization, fallback behavior, compliance, link validation, and test-profile verification—not just copywriting.
Templates standardize layout and approved patterns.
Personalization syntax accesses profile, event, and contextual data and applies expressions.
Validation is not proof: validation checks configuration; proof checks what a person sees.
A contact address or device token does not automatically grant permission to contact.
XDM schemas define structure and meaning.
A dataset stores records conforming to a schema.
A union schema is a system-generated combined view of schemas that share a compatible class and are enabled for Real-Time Customer Profile.
Profile combines fragments from Profile-enabled datasets and identity relationships into a unified view.
An identity is an identifier for a person/entity.
Guardrails can limit audience complexity, evaluation methods, data volume, identity graph behavior, and processing capacity.
